up: List all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2321810. For each molecule, return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2321810';
